subdecisions.scope: Core HTTP Workspace/Document/Node/Relation/Revision command and query wire contracts
allowed_while_blocked: P4 shell and route work using no private Core schema
P1 internal Candidate/Publication authority tests that consume no external wire schema
subdecisions.safety_boundary: Only Core-native service and Core-rendered UI controls may perform accept. Plugin worker, Plugin UI Bundle, Plugin SDK and plugin RPC expose no direct Publication callable. Plugin UI intent may request a Core operation or candidate preview only; it cannot carry a publication mutation.

subdecisions.scope: Core HTTP Asset metadata and bounded read-range DTO
allowed_while_blocked: existing plugin host.asset.read/v1 and host.asset.create/v1 use unchanged
subdecisions.compatibility_rule: Existing host Asset RPC remains byte- and field-compatible; this is a separate Core HTTP DTO, not a new plugin method.

subdecisions.scope: P1 Core schema migration receipt/DB record
subdecisions.allowed: P1 may define a deterministic internal receipt in its own migration/domain/repository write set and include it in P1 delivery evidence.
subdecisions.forbidden: Do not add it to rpc-method-matrix.v1, plotpilot-plugin-sdk, Plugin UI, or Core HTTP API. Do not change migration.apply/v1; its applied_schema/receipt_hash remains the plugin install migration contract.

version_policy.rule: No Core HTTP wire family was published in M0. These are first-publication additive v1 families inside the already-frozen Core API 1.x window, not edits to an existing M0 v1 field, method, hash, frame, lease, state or cursor. Once published, any change to one of these families follows §84.8 and requires a new v2 family plus ADR.
version_policy.manifest_rule: Regenerate the current content-addressed contract manifest to include the new v1 files and fixtures. Preserve the M0 historical manifest bytes/hash through M0-OPEN-R4; do not rewrite any old tag or historical delivery artifact.
version_policy.rpc_rule: Do not add Core HTTP methods to rpc-method-matrix.v1 or change plugin RPC compatibility.

common: Every request/response is a closed Draft 2020-12 DTO; no arbitrary metadata map or untyped command payload.
IDs, UTC strings, SHA-256 and JCS/hash rules reuse §84.1; all write commands carry an operation_key and all revision-affecting writes carry an explicit expected/base revision.
Unknown fields, unknown entity/workspace references, cross-workspace targets, stale CAS bases and operation-key payload reuse are rejected with typed Core HTTP error responses.

dto_families: workspace/v1: workspace_id, workspace_kind, title, status, current_plan_revision_id|null, created_at, updated_at, revision
document/v1: document_id, workspace_id, document_type, title, current_revision_id|null, created_at, updated_at, revision
node/v1: node_id, workspace_id, document_id|null, node_type, title, parent_node_id|null, position, current_revision_id|null, created_at, updated_at, revision
relation/v1: relation_id, workspace_id, relation_type, source_id, target_id, revision_id|null, created_at
revision/v1: revision_id, workspace_id, document_id|null, node_id|null, parent_revision_id|null, content_hash, created_by, source_candidate_id|null, created_at, revision_number, payload_schema
page/v1 and revision-content-page/v1: typed offset/limit/total/next_offset and bounded text read; entity DTOs never inline unbounded body text
commands: POST /api/v1/core/workspaces: create; PATCH /api/v1/core/workspaces/{workspace_id}: title/status update; DELETE /api/v1/core/workspaces/{workspace_id}: typed delete result
POST /api/v1/core/workspaces/{workspace_id}/documents: create; PATCH /api/v1/core/documents/{document_id}: bounded identity update
POST /api/v1/core/workspaces/{workspace_id}/nodes: create; PATCH /api/v1/core/nodes/{node_id}: title/parent/position structure command; DELETE /api/v1/core/nodes/{node_id}: typed delete result
POST /api/v1/core/workspaces/{workspace_id}/relations: create; DELETE /api/v1/core/relations/{relation_id}: typed delete result
POST /api/v1/core/documents/{document_id}/revisions and POST /api/v1/core/nodes/{node_id}/revisions: explicit CAS revision write returning the typed resulting Revision

publication.result: publication-result/v1: publication_id, candidate_id, workspace_id, entity_kind, entity_id, resulting_revision, idempotent
required_server_checks: verify payload hash, RunSnapshot/provenance/release identity, target/mutation/base/write-set and parent closure
write Publication receipt and revision.published event
same key and payload returns the first result; different payload fails

asset.metadata_query: GET /api/v1/core/assets/{asset_id} -> asset-metadata/v1: asset_id, sha256, mime, size, logical_role, provenance, rebuildable
asset.range_query: GET /api/v1/core/assets/{asset_id}/range?offset=&length= -> asset-read-range/v1: asset_id, offset, length, total_size, base64_chunk, next_offset|null, content_hash
asset.limits: Bounded non-negative offset/length; response bytes and exact SHA-256 are checked. No public upload/create method is introduced by this Delta.

required_p0_artifacts: closed JSON Schemas for all DTO/request/result families
positive and negative HTTP fixtures, including stale CAS, cross-workspace, unknown field, duplicate operation key, partial Publication and Asset range bounds
P1/P4 typed port fakes that implement only this matrix
manifest/content hashes, compatibility note and ADR linkage
required_runtime_checks: Python validator and real frontend/src/contracts verifier
proof that plugin SDK/RPC has no direct Publication method
P1/P4 integration must consume only the published P0 contract

luna_review.rule: A future Luna implementation is an execution draft only; Sol must inspect the actual diff and raw test output before P0 accepts it.

sync_order: P1 may submit an integration-ready/v1 batch limited to internal authority/domain/repository/assets/candidates/backup and deterministic internal migration; public Core API/Publication slice stays stopped.
P0 validates that batch and integrates it with git merge --no-ff; no submission may be inferred from a branch or task status.
P0 publishes the above versioned contracts, fixtures, DTOs and validators on the integration branch and obtains Sol focused review.
P1 and P4 update clean worktrees with git merge --ff-only to the new P0 integration head; only then may P1 implement the public Core API/Publication adapter and P4 consume the HTTP DTOs.
P1/P4 must stop and raise a new Contract Delta if an implementation request changes any frozen v1 field, method, hash, error or CAS meaning.
prohibitions: Do not modify formal design v1.2 or project-matrix.json.
Do not modify P1/P4 worktrees or donor.
Do not add Publication to backend/plotpilot_plugin_sdk/ports.py or rpc-method-matrix.v1.json.
Do not create P1-P6 branches/worktrees/projects or first-party plugins beyond those already registered.
Do not build desktop/Tauri/EXE/installer or run broad browser regression for this adjudication.
